decisions.reason: The click-in adapter is the firm's flagship and a core part of its track system, which the industry's growth supports, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for alternatives.
This LED luminaire line sits close to the core range, and it is ageing after four years, but with no sign of underperformance the firm is more likely to update models than withdraw the line.

Home automation hardware becomes outdated quickly and lies further from the firm's lighting core, which makes it the most exposed product, but without evidence of a shortfall a modest-slack firm would probably still keep it.
The luminaire family had its own showcase page and fits the core offer, so with no reported shortfall against aspirations it is likely to be kept.
